passives.name: BenimaruEquipmentPassive1
passives.description:
If an enemy is within this unit's range:
- Gain {1} $Scorched stack every {2} seconds (Capacity : {3})
Enemies afflicted with $Scorched will :
- Take {4}% increased damage from $FireElement units
- Take {5}% increased damage from any $FireDoT
For every $FireElement unit placed or unique stack of $FireDoT on an enemy in this unit's range:
- Increase damage by {6}% (Capacity : {7}%)
- Increase buffs from $Scorched by {8}% (Capacity : {9}%)
